summary: Promontory Lookout northwest of Lower Nicola: established 1948, new tower by 1951, dismantled 2007; the recreation site stays open for day use.

facts.design: Plywood building on a concrete foundation, anchored to bedrock with steel cables (1951 description)
facts.status_note: Dismantled in 2007. The recreation site remains and is open for day use.

access.note: Recreation site open for day use. Reached by a rough forest service road that is seasonally deactivated in winter.

visit.trail_note: About 13 km of forest service road from Highway 8; very rough, narrow and winding; active logging near the 6 or 7 km mark; radio towers just past the recreation site.

events.note: A May 1951 Merritt Herald item says the lookout was established in 1948.
New tower and permanent building. The 1951 item says they were constructed late the previous summer, so 1950 is inferred from that wording.
A May 1967 Merritt Herald notice describes a round-the-clock fire watcher at the lookout, reached by collect call.
The lookout was dismantled. Joy of Exploring says this followed constant vandalism.

corrections.why: The tower was dismantled in 2007, but the recreation site is open for day use. The closed value describes the tower, not the site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The May 1951 item gives the mountain as 5700 feet (about 1,737 m). Joy of Exploring gives the site's altitude as 5625 feet (about 1,715 m). The two may measure different points or round differently; neither is confirmed as the lookout's height.

notes_for_editor: Three sources, all secondary or local-history transcriptions. The Sites and Trails BC record (REC1831), which the brief lists, returned no text to fetch_text, so it is not cited. Its search snippet matches the 2007 dismantling, but that is unverified here. The 1950 date for the new tower is inferred from 'late last summer' in a May 1951 item. The brief's Thompson-Nicola Regional District name is not confirmed by these pages, so it is left out of the story. Brief access 'closed' is corrected to 'public' for the day-use site. The brief's status 'unknown' is filled as removed. Elevation is conflicting (5700 ft vs 5625 ft) and is not stored as a fact.
